name: Legends of Esculone
desc:
Legends of Esculone is a medieval, rapid, third person immersive experience! Ravage through the battlefield with your friends and destroy the enemies dark conquest of terror before it breaches the castle. 

Play one of five unique classes, level up without a level cap and unlock new skills! defeat a variety of unique creatures and zombies, even summon your own! Protect the gate and rise through the darkness that swarms the forest.

BEGIN YOUR LEGEND TODAY!
【🪄】Use powerful dark magic and spells.
【🛡️】Protect the grand castle of Esculone.
【🔨】Build unique defences to demolish the large mobs.
【⚔️】Strike down with powerfully forged weapons.

Esculone awaits your bravery, traveller!
